# Core::Text



Text contains the standardized font styling which follows Jolt's design system. The text package uses the Open Sans font family and it is not a dependency of the package itself. Therefore, the fonts will need to be included in any projects that use this package.



## Installation



### React Native

1. Download the Open Sans fonts:
   https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Open+Sans?selection.family=Open+Sans
2. Put the following fonts in `projectRoot/assets/fonts` directory:
   - OpenSans-Regular.ttf
   - OpenSans-Light.ttf
   - OpenSans-SemiBold.ttf
3. Run `react-native link`
4. Check that your fonts have been installed correctly by checking the following:
   - For android the font files exist in `projectRoot/android/app/src/main/assets/fonts`
   - For iOS the fonts are listed in `projectRoot/ios/universal/Info.plist` under `<key>UIAppFonts</key>`.

### Web

1. Paste this `link` within the `head` component of your document 

   `<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Open+Sans:300,400,600" rel="stylesheet">`

###### Example:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
    <head>
        ...
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=Open+Sans:300,400,600" rel="stylesheet">
        ...
    </head>
    ...
</html>
```
